note: Six primitive camping spots, each at a small gravel lot. Four are along the improved gravel road in from Route RA at the north end: a gravel turnaround loop in an open bottom on the bank of Peno Creek, just before the road's concrete bridge over the creek; two roadside lots in timber past the shooting range; and the lot with a privy where the road ends. Two more sit on their own on county roads at the east side and the south edge (the south one has a privy and a mown lawn). No pads, tables or water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Designated Camping Sites' - six Primitive Camping symbols on the map, each beside a Parking Lot symbol, and six GIS camping points. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit; the brochure limits camping to designated areas (walk-in camping apart). Phone matches the area page. The pin is on a roadside spot under canopy; the creek-bank loop is the clearest camp - pin move and a creekside lead flagged.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays): the area page lists 'Camping: Designated Camping Sites' (and walk-in/backpack open camping); the brochure says 'Camping is permitted only in designated areas' and 'Walk-in camping is allowed year round EXCEPT during all firearms deer and turkey seasons. During these seasons camping is allowed on or adjacent to graveled area parking lots.' The map (3/28/2022) draws six Primitive Camping symbols, each beside a Parking Lot symbol; GIS layer 27 has six points (OBJECTIDs 635 'Designated Camping Area', 202, 204, 205, 206, 207 'Primitive Camping Area'). Every spot is a lot with a designated camping point, so it stays under the 2026-11-09 rule. No horse camp is labelled.

CLUSTERS: (a) north end, one improved road in from Route RA, four spots within 1 km of each other: 635 at 39.45919,-91.28974 (gravel turnaround loop about 35 m across in an open grassy bottom on the north bank of Peno Creek, reached before the bridge); 205 at 39.45557,-91.29147 (the stored pin: a roadside point under closed canopy, its lot 19 m away not visible on the leaf-on frame); 204 at 39.45578,-91.29659 (a gravel pull-out about 15 x 20 m at a road bend); 206 at 39.45422,-91.30101 (road-end gravel lot with a privy beside a mown opening; ADA lot). (b) 207 at 39.43343,-91.29098, 2.5 km south on county road 50 at the east boundary: a small lot under canopy, single lot. (c) 202 at 39.41816,-91.30845, 4.4 km south on county road 48 at the south boundary: a gravel lot about 30 x 15 m with a privy, mown lawn with scattered trees behind it. NO SPLIT proposed: (b) and (c) are each on their own road but each is a single small lot, which the split rule excludes.

PIN MOVE (main camp): stored 39.45557,-91.29147 is GIS point 205, a minor roadside spot under canopy. The clearest camp is the Peno Creek loop, the only spot with a loop and open ground: 39.45919,-91.28985 (centre of the loop on the 110 m leaf-off frame; GIS point 635 is on its east side at 39.45919,-91.28974), about 430 m north-north-east of the stored pin.

WATERFRONT LEAD UP (stored not waterfront, read at the roadside pin; I did not change it): if the pin moves to the Peno Creek loop, the loop's south edge is about 10-15 m from the creek bank on the leaf-off frame, with a few bare bank trees and no road, trail or day use between; the creek is a pool about 12-15 m wide there (under 30 m, so 'creekside' is the word). The whole camp is that one loop, so every rig on it is within about 45 m of the water. Leaf-on the bank trees close in. Bank height cannot be judged from imagery.

ACCESS: 'From Frankford, take Highway 61 south 3 miles, then Route RA west.' The map legend shows the road through the north end as 'MDC Improved Road'. The loop is reached before the creek; the three other north-end spots are beyond a concrete bridge over Peno Creek (a deck bridge about 15 m long with abutments on the leaf-off frame, not a slab ford). No low-water crossing, 4WD wording or posted limit on the page, brochure or map. OSM was unread (the Overpass mirror timed out).
PHONE: stored 573-248-2530 matches the area page's 'For more information call (573) 248-2530'.
SEASON: stored year_round (manual) stands; the brochure puts no season on the designated areas (only walk-in camping is shut out during firearms deer and turkey seasons).
